paragraph.en-US: Play the Clockwright if you want to field small automata that fight beside you.
You have a clockwork companion the size of a cat. It can carry small objects and scout within Far range.
You have advantage on action rolls to repair, unlock or disarm mechanisms.
Your companion can make an attack using your Spellcast Roll for d6+2 physical damage.
Once per long rest, when your companion would be destroyed, it keeps ticking with 1 Hit Point.
You may field a second companion.
